findings.text: blocking: "Every lane is below 2.3e-9 by iterate 2" is false and is contradicted three lines above by the record's own table and by lanes-paths.json paths.residual[lane][2], where lanes 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 15 and 16 sit at 1.64e-7; the paragraph's next sentence then starts from "the plateau level of 1.6e-7", so the estimate rests on a starting point the record refutes, and the same overstatement at :12 ("within two orders of the tolerance after two Newton steps") must be corrected with it.

blocking: the driver's step vector quoted for the failed host transcription, [5,14,7,11,18,9,5,12,12,11,6,9,5,6,5,11], is not the vector in the log that paragraph cites; lanes-trace.log's AssertionError prints [7,3,3,4,7,6,8,8,3,14,10,9,5,4,5,7], while the quoted vector is the earlier allocation's, so the two vectors are spliced across jobs and a reader cannot reproduce the stated disagreement.
non-blocking: "max 18, median 6" misstates its own vector; [5,14,7,11,18,9,5,12,12,11,6,9,5,6,5,11] has median 9.0, and the manifest's evidence_inputs repeats the same 6.

non-blocking: "that iterate is 3 for seven lanes and 4 for eight" miscounts; the trace gives first non-contracting iterate 3 for seven lanes, 4 for seven, and 5 for lane 3, with lane 8 never stalling.

non-blocking: "the residual falls 1.2e-1 to 3.9e-4 to 1.6e-7, roughly 2.4 decades per step" misstates the second step, which is 3.4 decades; the same 2.4-to-2.5 figure is reused at :65 as the rate "the first three unlocked steps already show", while those steps show 2.49, 3.1 and 3.4 decades.

non-blocking: "the residual and the update take only two values" is contradicted by the accepting iterate, which lands on a third, lower level (lane 5 ends at 1.08e-11, lane 7 at 5.4e-11) as the same paragraph's "an iterate lands below both" implies.

non-blocking: the brief's clause (1) asks the trace to record the condition estimate per iterate and changes in the cut-cell, normal-form and selected-fragment sets; the record answers the sets only by inference from a zero unfreeze counter and reports no condition estimate at all.

non-blocking: save_checked is copied from scripts/prototypes/bank_solve_read/plot.py:33 (and bank_solve_profile/plot.py:45, bank_solve_driver/plot.py:28) instead of imported, so a fifth copy must be maintained; it also implements only two of the three mandated checks, which is why the freeze-threshold annotation renders struck through by the dotted line it names.
non-blocking: the slowest lane is drawn in #c0442b red, which the style reserves for a limit being broken, and the second slowest in #d98a2b, in the muddy ochre family the style bans.

non-blocking: "echo EXIT=$?" sits inside a brace group under set -e, so it is unreachable when trace.py fails; lanes-trace.log ends with the AssertionError traceback and carries no EXIT line, leaving a failed gate's status unreadable.

non-blocking: the tests line reads "none: this measurement node adds no tests ...", a description rather than the literal command a shell was handed, so the gate receipt cannot be filled from it and must fall back to the log's own command header.
